top_signals.title: Citadel Securities Says Bull Market Drivers Are ‘Firmly Intact’
top_signals.summary: Forces that propelled US stocks to record highs this year remain “firmly intact” after a reset in retail investors’ speculative trading, according to Citadel Securities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
